texto:
I am sorry, my God, and I repent with all my heart for having offended you.
I am sorry for the hell I deserved and for the heaven I lost.
But much more I am sorry because by sinning I offended a God as good and as great as you.
I would rather have died than have offended you, and I firmly resolve to sin no more and to avoid every near occasion of sin.
Amen.
